traceability.detail: HRM-ROLL-01 Finishing Mill Work Roll Chock clamp: ROLL_GAP_UNSTABLE. Symptoms: roll gap variation; strip thickness deviation. Root cause: Loose chock clamp after roll change. Action: Retorqued clamp, checked alignment, monitored next 20 coils.

traceability.title: Hydraulic pressure instability SOP
traceability.detail: 1. Confirm sensor reading from local gauge and control system historian. 2. Check pump, accumulator pressure, valve leakage, and seal condition. 3. If pressure drop affects a critical motion, stop the motion sequence and isolate the hydraulic circuit. 4. Review spare availability for seal kit, servo valve, and hose assembly. 5. Record action taken and actual root cause in the digital maintenance log.
